items.source: Factory method to create an InstanceSupplier from a ThrowingSupplier.
items.translation: 工厂方法，用于从 ThrowingSupplier 创建 InstanceSupplier。

items.source: a new InstanceSupplier
items.translation: 一个新的InstanceSupplier

items.source: supplier - the source supplier
items.translation: supplier - 源供应商

items.source: Specialized Supplier that can be set on a BeanDefinition when details about the registered bean are needed to supply the instance.
items.translation: 专用的 `Supplier`，可设置在`BeanDefinition`上，以便在需要有关 `registered bean` 的详细信息来提供实例时使用。

items.source: Description copied from interface: ThrowingSupplier
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：ThrowingSupplier

items.source: Lambda friendly method that can be used to create an InstanceSupplier and add post processors in a single call. For example: InstanceSupplier.of(registeredBean -> ...).andThen(...).
items.translation: Lambda 友好的方法，可用于创建 `InstanceSupplier` 并在单次调用中添加后置处理器。例如：InstanceSupplier.of(registeredBean -> ...).andThen(...)。

items.source: Lambda friendly method that can be used to create an InstanceSupplier and add post processors in a single call.
items.translation: 可用于创建 InstanceSupplier 并一次性添加后置处理器的 Lambda 友好方法。

items.source: Return a composed instance supplier that first obtains the instance from this supplier and then applies the after function to obtain the result.
items.translation: 返回一个组合的实例供应器，该供应器首先从 `this` 供应器获取实例，然后应用 `after` 函数以获取结果。

items.source: Return the factory method that this supplier uses to create the instance, or null if it is not known or this supplier uses another means.
items.translation: 返回该供应者用于创建实例的工厂方法，如果未知或该供应者使用其他手段，则返回 `null`。

items.source: Get the supplied instance.
items.translation: 获取提供的实例。

items.source: Gets a result, possibly throwing a checked exception.
items.translation: 获取结果，可能会抛出受检异常。

items.translation: `getWithException` 在接口 `ThrowingSupplier<T>` 中

items.translation: V - after 函数的输出类型，以及组合函数的输出类型
